existing_h1: Ransomware Attacks on Government and Defense in the UAE

hard_rules: NEVER name, describe or hint at an affected organisation. Sector, group and date only.
NEVER mention .onion addresses, leak contents, data volumes or employee names.
NEVER claim DESC, NESA or ISO 27001 accreditation. Never offer certification as a service.
NEVER invent a number. Every figure must appear in this brief. If unsure, write [VERIFY].
A leak-site claim is an attacker assertion, not a confirmed breach. Word it that way.
ADHICS (Abu Dhabi healthcare) and CBUAE (banking) are deliberately not referenced anywhere on this site pending a scope review. Do not mention them.

facts: methodologically aligned with ISO 27001 and NIST CSF
regulatory_context.scope: Dubai government entities, semi-government organisations, cloud providers serving Dubai government, and key suppliers handling government data

regulatory_context.name: UAE IAS v2
facts: 39 Priority One controls mandatory for everything in scope
regulatory_context.scope: Critical national infrastructure operators and government entities across all emirates

regulatory_context.name: UAE PDPL
regulatory_context.scope: Any organisation processing personal data of individuals in the UAE

what_the_page_already_says: A lede paragraph with the headline count, a stat bar, a table of groups active in this sector, and a table of claims by period. Do not repeat these. Add what they do not say.
